fullTextEN: Hello everyone, I am Nika.
I am from China.

fullTextZH: 现在住在安徽省合肥市。
fullTextEN: I currently live in Hefei, Anhui Province.

fullTextZH: 最近，很多国家的人都喜欢一个玩具。
fullTextEN: Recently, people from many countries like a toy.
It was designed by a Chinese company.
BLACKPINK's Lisa also loves it.

fullTextZH: 很多照片里都有它的影子。
fullTextEN: It appears in many photos.

fullTextZH: 后来，很多明星也跟着买起来。
fullTextEN: Later, many celebrities also started buying it.
It has pointy ears,
and a row of small sharp teeth on its face,

fullTextZH: 表情像一个调皮又可爱的孩子。
fullTextEN: with an expression like a mischievous and cute child.
Do you know what it is?
Oh, it is Labubu.
Labubu is very popular.

fullTextZH: 现在，中国卖拉布布的地方常常
fullTextEN: Now, places in China selling Labubu often
can't buy it.
I went to Japan last month,

fullTextZH: 每个卖拉布布的店门口
fullTextEN: and at the entrance of every store selling Labubu
there were long lines.
You might ask:
Isn't this just a little toy?

fullTextZH: 为什么大家都抢着去买，
fullTextEN: Why is everyone rushing to buy it,
lining up in long queues to buy it?

fullTextZH: 有的人还愿意多花很多的钱去买呢！”
fullTextEN: Some people are even willing to spend a lot of money to buy it!
Today, let's talk about
young people around the world

fullTextZH: 为什么这么爱这个中国小玩具。
fullTextEN: why they love this Chinese toy so much.
First, let's talk about the appearance of Labubu.
The toys we usually see,

fullTextZH: 大多都是圆圆的大眼睛、
fullTextEN: mostly have big round eyes,
sweet smiles,
like hello Kitty.
But Labubu is different.
It has 9 sharp little teeth,
its expression looks a bit
naughty, oh,

fullTextZH: 像个调皮的、做了坏事的孩子。
fullTextEN: like a mischievous child who did something bad.

fullTextZH: 可就是这种特别的样子、
fullTextEN: But it's this special appearance,
imperfect appearance,
that makes it seem especially cute.
This company is called Pop Mart,
The boss is called Wang Ning.
Wang Ning was born in China,
His family was very ordinary,

fullTextZH: 但是他小时候就会做生意，
fullTextEN: but he could do business from a young age,
He made money at 18 years old,
Very impressive.

fullTextZH: 王宁大学毕业之后开了自己的公司，
fullTextEN: After Wang Ning graduated from university, he started his own company,
The name was Pop Mart.

fullTextZH: 刚开始，公司卖很多东西，
fullTextEN: At first, the company sold many things,

fullTextZH: 比如玩具汽车、耳机、糖果等等。
fullTextEN: such as toy cars, headphones, candies, etc.
But the business got worse and worse.

fullTextZH: 最后，王宁决定只卖玩具。
fullTextEN: Finally, Wang Ning decided to only sell toys.
He found a toy,
Its name was Molly.
At that time, not many people knew about Molly,
Unexpectedly, Molly sold very well,
The company made a lot of money.
Since then,

fullTextZH: 泡泡玛特在全世界都火了。
fullTextEN: Pop Mart became popular worldwide.

fullTextZH: 现在，拉布布是他们公司最火的玩具。
fullTextEN: Now, Labubu is the most popular toy in their company.

fullTextZH: 拉布布是中国香港设计师设计的。
fullTextEN: Labubu was designed by a designer from Hong Kong, China.
This designer is called Long Jia Sheng.

fullTextZH: 刚开始，拉布布的样子更凶一点、
fullTextEN: At first, Labubu looked a bit fiercer,
a bit meaner,
with a square face,
and narrow eyes,
like a little monster.

fullTextZH: 后来，设计师把他的脸改成圆的，
fullTextEN: Later, the designer changed his face to be round,
and enlarged the eyes,
becoming the current look.

fullTextZH: 这种样子不是传统的可爱，
fullTextEN: This look is not traditionally cute,
but very special.
My friend said,

fullTextZH: 他觉得拉布布就像另一个自己，
fullTextEN: he feels Labubu is like another self,
looking a bit fierce,
but actually very kind and good-hearted.
Seeing Labubu's little sharp teeth,

fullTextZH: 就想到自己小时候调皮的样子，
fullTextEN: he thinks of his own mischievous childhood self,
very happy. Besides the special look,

fullTextZH: 买拉布布还有一个很好玩的过程，
fullTextEN: Buying Labubu also has a very fun process,
drawing a blind box.
What is a blind box?
It's when you buy it,

fullTextZH: 完全看不到盒子里的拉布布
fullTextEN: you can't see the Labubu inside the box at all
what it looks like.
You are like a blind person,
unable to see, so it's called a blind box.

fullTextZH: 拉布布也有很多不同的样子。
fullTextEN: Labubu also comes in many different forms.

fullTextZH: 每个人都有自己最喜欢的拉布布。
fullTextEN: Everyone has their favorite Labubu.
In your blind box,

fullTextZH: 是不是你喜欢的那个拉布布，
fullTextEN: is it the Labubu you like,
depends on your luck.

fullTextZH: 运气好，你就能买到你喜欢的拉布布；
fullTextEN: If you're lucky, you can get the Labubu you like;
If you're unlucky,

fullTextZH: 有可能就不是你喜欢的拉布布了。
fullTextEN: it might not be the Labubu you like.
Yes, it all depends on luck.

fullTextZH: 这种不知道盲盒里是什么的感觉，
fullTextEN: This feeling of not knowing what's in the blind box,

fullTextZH: 让打开盒子的瞬间充满了期待。
fullTextEN: makes the moment of opening the box full of anticipation.
When many people buy,

fullTextZH: 都会紧张地摇一摇盒子，
fullTextEN: Everyone nervously shakes the box,

fullTextZH: 希望能抽到自己喜欢的盲盒。
fullTextEN: hoping to draw a blind box they like.

fullTextZH: 当然，拉布布这么受欢迎，
fullTextEN: Of course, Labubu is so popular,

fullTextZH: 还有一个很重要的原因，
fullTextEN: there is another important reason,

fullTextZH: 就是这个公司不会做很多的拉布布。
fullTextEN: which is that the company doesn't make many Labubus.
You can't just buy it whenever you want,
so everyone rushes to buy them,
everyone lines up for a long time
to buy them.

fullTextZH: 这样，拉布布就更受欢迎、更贵了。
fullTextEN: This way, Labubu becomes even more popular and expensive.

fullTextZH: 很多人买拉布布，会给它穿衣服、戴帽子，
fullTextEN: Many people who buy Labubu dress it up and put hats on it,

fullTextZH: 把它当成自己的小宝贝一样去照顾。
fullTextEN: treating it like their own little treasure.
Young people all over the world,

fullTextZH: 在网上发自己和拉布布的合照，
fullTextEN: post photos of themselves with Labubu online,

fullTextZH: 让拉布布的名气越来越大。
fullTextEN: making Labubu's fame grow bigger and bigger.

fullTextZH: 拉布布还经常和有名的品牌合作，
fullTextEN: Labubu often collaborates with famous brands,
for example,

fullTextZH: 和可口可乐一起设计了爱喝可乐的
fullTextEN: designing with Coca-Cola a Labubu that loves to drink cola
Labubu.

fullTextZH: 这些合作款卖得非常快，
fullTextEN: These collaboration editions sell very quickly,
As soon as it came out, it was snatched up.

fullTextZH: 还有人会给拉布布涂上新的颜色、
fullTextEN: Some people even paint new colors on Labubu,
make new clothes,

fullTextZH: 甚至改变它的表情，让它变得更特别。
fullTextEN: even change its expression to make it more special.

This small toy,
